profile.headline: Software Developer I at YPrime
profile.summary: 5 plus years of professional experience in the field of Software Testing. Comprehensive knowledge of software testing methodology which include both waterfall and agile development. Good experience in testing of IWR/IVR/ePro applications. Testing experience includes functional and regression testing of software products and features prior to production implementation. In-depth knowledge of testing the different phases of software development life-cycle. Proven ability to work as a part of a team as well as independently, self-motivated, task oriented and quick at learning a new tools and technologies. Possess excellent analytical, documentation and communication skills.

positions.title: Software Developer I
positions.description:
•	Work as part of a cross-functional project team to deliver custom software solutions that
streamline the clinical trial process for pharmaceutical and biotech clients
•	Review user requirements specifications, verifying that all requirements can be implemented
with the YPrime software in the required timeframe
•	Develop software systems that are reliable, maintainable, and efficient, with emphasis on
patient safety and integrity of clinical study data
•	Manage the deployment of application code into all environments, complete all required
documentation
•	Understand the individual design requirements for a specific client implementation and
create any required custom development.
•	Be conversant across front and back-end development to make modifications and
enhancements across all aspects of the system.

positions.title: Senior Technical Delivery Analyst
positions.description: Serve as a team lead, leading, mentoring, and training the team on the configuration of the yprime product. Work directly with the project manager to build/configure mockup design of the software, support project delivery team with development and implementation of IRT/eCOA system to deliver custom software solution for clinical trial process for pharmaceutical clients. Serve as a subject matter expert on the Yprime unified system, providing guidance, direction to deliver configuration of the system.

positions.title: Testing Analyst (Intern)
positions.description:
•	Manual Black box testing of the web application
•	Perform all aspects of verification including functional, Usability, 
•	Interface and compatibility testing of every build
•	Designed and developed Test plans and Test cases 
•	Execute test cases using Testlink to compare the actual result with expected results 
•	Log and track defects in Mantis defect tracking system.

positions.title: Manager/Owner at Citgo Pertrolium Station
positions.description:
•	Run the station inside and outside efficiently. 
•	Use basic math skills to count and account for all station cash, receipts, and inventory.
•	Maintain various reports on daily, weekly, and monthly basis.
•	Review and maintain inventory procedures, order from vendors and review all invoices.
•	Meet with vendors, clean and rotate merchandise.

positions.title: Assistant Tech Manager
positions.description:
Handled customers' questions and concerns both over the phone and in person
Trained new employees
Data maintenance with the use of Retail Pro & Performed inventory Management.
